decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp, Ephemerate, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck can protect its threats and control the board while pressuring the opponent. The combination of aggressive creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push allow the deck to quickly establish a dominant position on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Solitude and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide additional versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for blinking or flickering them in and out of play. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can repeatedly trigger powerful effects from creatures like Quantum Riddler and Overlord of the Balemurk. Additionally, the deck includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the tempo of the game. The key strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and synergistic aggro/blink strategy while disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked in and out of play to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to keep the pressure on while controlling the board with removal spells like Solitude and Fatal Push. Additionally, the deck includes powerful enchantments like Witch Enchanter and Quantum Riddler to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays with a mix of removal and protection spells to maintain board control. The deck utilizes a variety of creatures with strong abilities to overwhelm opponents quickly while also providing some utility through cards like Ephemerate and Thraben Charm. The inclusion of cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Skyclave Apparition helps to further disrupt opponents' strategies, while Guide of Souls and Witch Enchanter provide additional synergies with the deck's creature base. The mana base is designed for consistency and flexibility, allowing for smooth gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate massive amounts of tokens and pump them up to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Emrakul, the Promised End for disruption and win conditions. The deck utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings to find key pieces quickly and efficiently. Overall, the strategy revolves around building a board presence with tokens and powerful creatures to secure victory in a Modern 1 vs 1 match.

The deck utilizes a combination of creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Basking Broodscale with cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Kozilek's Command to create a powerful, synergistic strategy. With the help of Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Delighted Halfling and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional utility and ways to generate advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on efficiently executing its combo while controlling the game state.

The deck aims to quickly cycle through cards and fill the graveyard with large creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Oliphaunt. It then uses cards like Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End, which will then bring all the creatures back from the graveyard onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect the combo and control the game. Overall, the key strategy is to control the board and win with a sudden and explosive combo.

The deck focuses on using powerful creatures like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to fill the graveyard quickly, then casting Living End to bring them all back into play for a devastating board presence. It also has cards like Violent Outburst and Force of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's mana base includes various lands to ensure it can cast its spells efficiently. With strong synergy between its cards, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden flood of creatures from the graveyard.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a strategic use of blink effects to maximize value from creatures with powerful abilities. By repeatedly blinking key creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ephemerate, Solitude, and Flickerwisp allows for flexibility in dealing with threats and maintaining board presence. The deck also features disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures and planeswalkers, while using control elements such as Thought-Knot Seer and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and control the game through powerful spells and abilities, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with threats they cannot easily deal with. The inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void further solidifies the control aspect of the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate a large amount of mana. Using powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command, as well as disruption spells like Trinisphere and Sowing Mycospawn, the deck aims to deny resources to the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful threats. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provide additional utility and win conditions, making this a versatile and formidable control deck in Modern 1vs1 format.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly develop a board presence and overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures. Using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to ramp up mana production, the deck can quickly play out threats like Kappa Cannoneer and Pinnacle Emissary. Engineered Explosives and Metallic Rebuke provide disruption against opposing strategies, while Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard. Urza's Saga provides additional artifact support, while Tormod's Crypt and Pithing Needle disrupt opposing graveyard and activated abilities. The goal is to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using powerful creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while setting up for a game-winning combo using Living End to bring all creatures back from the graveyard at once. The deck includes a variety of cards that can manipulate the graveyard, counter opposing spells, and provide card advantage. By carefully managing resources and timing the Living End activation, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden surge of powerful creatures and take control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal direct damage to the opponent quickly, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge adds additional damage potential, while Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card draw and selection. The mana base includes fetch lands like Bloodstained Mire and Wooded Foothills to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to maintain pressure on the opponent by maximizing damage output and efficiency. The deck includes cheap creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. It also includes card draw spells like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to ensure consistency and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck is designed to quickly end the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using instant reanimate spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield quickly. By cycling through the deck with cards like Faithful Mending and Tainted Indulgence, and disrupting opponents with Force of Negation and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces. The unique combination of creatures like Psychic Frog, Superior Spider-Man, and Quantum Riddler along with support spells like Ephemerate and Prismatic Ending provide a versatile and resilient strategy.
